description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTimesheetItemAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee timesheet entries within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, and validating timesheet data, integrating various traits for authentication, validation, and entity management, and follows OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetItemAPI
classes.description: API controller for managing employee timesheet entries, providing endpoints for retrieving detailed timesheet data and updating entries, incorporating validation, authentication, and transaction management.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve detailed timesheet entries along with metadata, including allowed actions and total durations.

methods.name: getTimesheet
methods.description: Fetches a specific timesheet by ID after verifying user permissions; throws exceptions if not found or inaccessible.

methods.name: getResultMetaForGetAll
methods.description: Constructs metadata response including dates, totals, allowed actions, and related employee and timesheet info for GET responses.

methods.name: getNormalizedEmployee
methods.description: Normalizes Employee entity data into a structured array for API response.

methods.name: getNormalizedTimesheet
methods.description: Normalizes Timesheet entity data into a structured array for API response.

methods.name: getNormalizedTotalDuration
methods.description: Normalizes total duration integer into a structured array for API response.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request parameters.

methods.name: getTimesheetIdParamRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for timesheetId parameter to ensure it's a positive integer.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Not implemented; method intended for creating new entries.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Not implemented; validation rules for create operation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; method intended for deleting entries.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; validation rules for delete operation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Not implemented; method to retrieve a single record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Not implemented; validation rules for getOne operation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update timesheet entries, including deletion and creation of entries within a transactional context.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating timesheet entries, including ensuring timesheetId is valid and entries data conforms.
